description: Rejects one buyer's offer on the caller's own listing on XP -- 'reject the lowball offer on my tickets'. confirm=false returns a preview of the offer; confirm=true rejects it, and only that call returns success=true. identifier and offer_uuid come from get_my_listing_status. Requires sign-in and the write:listings scope.

confirm.description: Required. True to reject the offer; False to preview without rejecting.

identifier.description: Public listing identifier from list_my_listings or get_my_listing_status.

name: reject_offer
title: Reject Offer
